changelog: New voice command "copy last line" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ লাইন কপি করো" in Bengali) and the line right before the cursor is copied to the clipboard in one step, so you can paste it anywhere without the two-step "select last line" + "copy". It is the one-segment version of v14.9's select. The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 53 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
